newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks remain up in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks remain up in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices remained higher in late Monday trade, but brokers said slow turnover indicated cautious sentiment which was preventing the index from rising further.
With 30 minutes left at 0330 GMT, the index was up 18.70 points or 0.23 percent at 8,197.40. Turnover was a modest T$64 billion.
"The market is encountering strong technical resistance and current turnover is too small to fuel an upward momentum," said National Securities analyst Alex Yang.
Electronics rose 1.18 percent, with "king share" Asustek surging the daily seven percent limit.
